summary: Five of the six criteria in this batch reached Adequate. The remaining criterion needs Phase 13 because a requirements stage whose agent exits before the first response cannot restart from Needs you. The audit also fixed the Home status probe race when a controller releases its lock. The whole PRD has 26 Adequate criteria, 32 Weak criteria and one waiting for Phase 13.

needsYou.problem: Earlier audits lost assessors when the checkpoint admission lock timed out. One live attempt's gate file grew to 16.7 MB while parallel sessions were contending on it.
needsYou.action: Investigate gate file growth and the five-second admission deadline in src/live/gate.ts.

needsYou.problem: The tests now show that a refused choice launches no stage and that a started stage keeps its original agent. Retrying a stage whose agent exited before its first response still needs Phase 13.
needsYou.action: Review this row if the fresh-session retry is still unproven after Phase 13.

settled.how: Real Chrome and authenticated controller tests prove opening without a stage launch, reopening a live or stopped run, and showing all live states. The lock-release race is fixed and covered. AC-HOME-05 is Adequate.
